name: settings.battery.charge_indicator_source
evidence: The battery UI builder creates an image object at 0x0c54ec3c, loads that object into R0 and the charge indicator path into R1, and calls the image-source veneer at 0x0c54ec52. The veneer branches to lv_image_set_src. The page root is set on creation and zeroed by cleanup.
scope: the specified charge-indicator image-source call while the battery page is active
